stem: Pioneer Genomics runs constant baseline compute plus nightly interruptible rendering jobs and wants the lowest blended EC2 price profile.

choices.text: Run all instances as On-Demand for full flexibility
Purchase Zonal Reserved Instances for entire peak demand and avoid Spot
Use Spot Instances for baseline and rendering capacity
Cover baseline with commitments and run rendering on Spot.

rationale: Baseline demand is predictable and fits commitment discounts, while interruptible rendering jobs are a strong Spot candidate. All On-Demand ignores available commitment savings. Covering full peak with Reserved capacity often overcommits for transient rendering bursts. Spot-only baseline risks interruption on steady-state workload that should be stable.
